3. Merchant will be solely responsible for the 
transactions carried out using this service.
4. The Merchant shall have account in SIFCO in order 
to receive the payment made   for the service by the 
customer through mobile banking under Fonepay 
Network.
5. The merchant shall display the promotional materials 
and QR code provided by SIFCO in noticeable area.
6. SIFCO is not liable for any dispute arises between 
the merchant and the mobile banking customer 
about the service delivery, quality of service and 
goods as the SIFCO’s service transaction is based on 
real time.
7. SIFCO will charge the merchant with appropriate 
fee as agreed by the merchant in this application 
which may change from time to time. The fee will 
be debited from the account of merchant based on 
the debit authority signed by the merchant in this 
application form. 
8. The Merchant warrants, represents and certifies 
that all information supplied by the Merchant and 
any other documentation submitted in support of 
this agreement including, among others, a copy of 
the Merchant business registration certificate, PAN 
certificate and other submitted documents, are 
complete, true and correct.
9. The Merchant shall ensure that the logo of SIFCO 
shall be display in parity with all other forms 
of payment supported by the Merchant on the 
Merchant’s business outlet where various payment 
options are featured for the purchase of good and/
or services. The Merchant shall present a truthful 
description of QR Code payment services in 
accordance with SIFCO.
10. The Merchant shall be solely liable for the complaints, 
goods rejections, disputes arising out of the illegal, 
false and defects and poor quality of products.
11. Both parties can terminate this Agreement by giving 
thirty (30) days prior notice in written. 
12. This Agreement comes into effect once it is signed by 
the merchant and remains valid until it is terminated 
with the clause mentioned above in clause no 11.
13. If either of the party or business of the party is found 
or declared illegal under the laws of Nepal by the 
authority of Nepal government or court in Nepal, 
the other party shall terminate this agreement with 
or without further notification to the party.
14. All disputes and differences relating to charges or 
claim arising out of QR Code transaction or as to 
the clarification of this ‘Terms & Conditions’ shall 
be amicably settled by both party, if failed to settled 
amicably shall be exclusively come in jurisdiction of 
the court of Nepal..
15. The rights obtained under this ‘Terms & Conditions’ 
are not transferable without written approval from 
the SIFCO.
16. SIFCO, at its own discretion, is entitled to add, alter, 
delete or modify any of the terms and conditions 
contained herein by prior written intimation to 
merchant.
